node.title: Re: help declaring variables within perl one-liner
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
perl one-liners called from another perl script

You've already gotten answers to your question, so let me add: Don't do that! It is hardly ever necessary unless you're doing really fancy stuff, and what you showed here does not fall in that category. See [id://11120515|my node here] for various examples of editing files and overwriting the originals.
